blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) has provided more than P14 million in fisheries and aquaculture assistance to boost coastal communities in Sorsogon. On Friday, BFAR said in a statement the interventions include fish cages, fiberglass boats, and seaweed-processing equipment. READ: BFAR secures rights to longtime fisheries site in Alaminos City Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. said these interventions aim to address production and postharvest needs while helping coastal families build more sustainable livelihoods. “We are moving beyond quick fixes by pairing modern mariculture and sturdy vessels with critical postharvest assets to lift our coastal families out […]...
